name: Circle Grow
description: Shows the picture inside a circle that grows from a point; the rest is transparent. Drive `progress` from 0 (nothing) to 1 (the whole picture).

params.name: center
params.description: Circle center, 0..1 of the picture ([0, 0] = top-left)

params.name: softness
params.description: Edge width, part of the picture height
